title: PDF Parsing Evaluation Schema v1.0
description: Records errors found when comparing a PDF parser's output against the source PDF. Strictly separates PDF parsing errors (what the parser produced) from NLP/LLM interpretation errors (what a downstream model inferred). Do not record interpretation errors in this schema.

ErrorCategory.description: text_accuracy=OCR/extraction errors in character content; text_completeness=dropped sentences/paragraphs; reading_order=columns/floats merged in wrong order; section_structure=headings misclassified or merged; metadata=title/author/DOI/year wrong or missing; tables=cell content garbled, merged, or dropped; footnotes=footnote text merged into body or lost; references=citation list malformed or truncated; scientific_content_substitution=formulae/special characters replaced with wrong text (e.g. α→a, β→b)

ErrorType.description: parsing_error=the parser produced wrong/missing text from the PDF bytes; interpretation_error=the parsed text is correct but a downstream model/pipeline misunderstood it. Only parsing_error belongs in this schema. Record interpretation_error in the LLM extraction evaluation schema.

Severity.description: critical=makes a key fact unrecoverable (e.g. sample size dropped, hypothesis corrupted); major=significant loss affecting multiple sentences or a whole section; minor=affects one sentence or a non-essential element; cosmetic=formatting/whitespace only, content preserved

bounding_box.description: x0,y0,x1,y1 in PDF points if available

error_id.description: Unique within this run, e.g. E001

original_content.description: Exact text or description from the source PDF.

system_output.description: Exact text the parser produced in place of original_content.

comment.description: Why this matters; which downstream tasks are affected.

pdf_path.description: Relative path to source PDF, e.g. data/papers/pilot_10/Steffens....pdf

pdf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source PDF file.

parser_system.description: e.g. MinerU, Marker, PyMuPDF_Enhanced, GROBID, pdfplumber

configuration.description: Key parser settings used in this run.

runs.description: One entry per parser × paper combination.
